worst_flaw: The team reward hinges on a flat 50% coverage target with no evidence it is feasible or valuable for each queue, and nothing says the 50% figure itself will be re-checked against baseline before it is announced. The CSAT bonus stays in pay, and the design never checks whether pressure to add articles could pull agents away from CSAT or how the two incentives interact, beyond a lagging CSAT-drop pause.
